name: Atombit
blog_profile: Atombit operates through specialized sub-brands (Profusion for data-driven marketing intelligence, Amplify Analytix for advanced analytics) targeting financial services. Their methodology centers on AI-powered customer data platforms enabling real-time segmentation and next-best-action decisioning. Delivery model combines proprietary data science capabilities with consulting engagements across EU and India markets. Thought leadership themes emphasize GenAI applications in banking customer intelligence and predictive lifecycle analytics.

name: Sovanta
blog_profile: Sovanta positions as a specialized SAP-Qualtrics integration partner with deep expertise in embedding experience data within SAP BTP operational workflows. Their methodology centers on closing the experience-operational data gap through AI-powered analytics dashboards natively integrated into SAP environments. Delivery model leverages dual SAP and Qualtrics certifications to serve DACH enterprise clients in manufacturing and financial services. Thought leadership increasingly emphasizes AI agent deployment for automated insight-to-action workflows within SAP ecosystems.

name: New Metrics
blog_profile: New Metrics positions as the leading Qualtrics implementation partner for GCC government and public sector CX transformation. Their methodology emphasizes citizen experience maturity frameworks aligned to national digital transformation visions (Saudi Vision 2030, UAE digital government strategies). Delivery model combines Qualtrics platform expertise with deep regional government consulting relationships. Thought leadership focuses on public sector CX benchmarking, Arabic-language survey design, and experience-driven government service modernization.

name: Ipsos CX
blog_profile: Ipsos CX leverages its global research infrastructure to deliver enterprise CX measurement and advisory services anchored in proprietary consumer insights methodologies. Their approach combines large-scale survey research with advanced analytics to quantify experience ROI and loyalty economics. Delivery model integrates Medallia platform capabilities with Ipsos's research-driven consulting framework. Thought leadership themes consistently emphasize evidence-based CX strategy, consumer sentiment tracking, and cross-industry benchmarking for retail and financial services.

name: commonFont
blog_profile: commonFont positions as a specialized Qualtrics consulting partner focused on enterprise CX program design and optimization, with particular strength in banking and financial services. Their methodology emphasizes experience orchestration, AI agent deployment within Qualtrics workflows, and program maturity acceleration. Delivery model centers on deep Qualtrics platform expertise combined with industry-specific consulting. Thought leadership consistently addresses AI-powered experience management, survey design best practices, and ROI-driven CX program governance.

name: Higher Oak
blog_profile: Higher Oak is a UK-based Qualtrics Platinum Partner specializing in experience management program implementation across UK and European markets. Their methodology historically emphasizes Qualtrics platform deployment, survey design, and CX analytics for enterprise clients. Delivery model centers on technical Qualtrics implementation combined with strategic CX consulting. Extended content silence raises questions about current operational focus and market engagement levels.

name: Lukkap
blog_profile: Lukkap positions as a platform-agnostic CX and EX consulting firm serving Spain and Latin American markets with a human-centered design methodology. Their approach emphasizes customer journey mapping, employee experience transformation, and organizational change management as interconnected disciplines. Delivery model is consulting-led without strong technology platform dependencies. Thought leadership themes span CX strategy, workforce experience design, and cultural transformation in Spanish-speaking enterprise environments.

name: Izo
blog_profile: Izo positions as a leading CX consultancy across Iberoamerica with Qualtrics-certified implementation capabilities spanning 15+ Spanish-speaking markets. Their methodology combines Voice of Customer program design with digital experience optimization and CX strategy consulting. Delivery model integrates Qualtrics platform expertise with regional consulting presence across Latin America and Spain. Thought leadership focuses on CX maturity frameworks, customer journey optimization, and enterprise VoC program governance for Spanish-speaking enterprises.

name: Globant
blog_profile: Globant positions CX within its broader AI-driven digital transformation narrative through the Connected Experiences Studio. Their methodology emphasizes AI engineering, generative AI adoption, and technology-led experience redesign at enterprise scale. Delivery model leverages a large global engineering workforce with specialized studios covering different transformation domains. CX-specific thought leadership is subsumed within the larger corporate AI and digital modernization messaging, making standalone CX positioning less distinct compared to boutique CX consultancies.
